headword: {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}

definitions.explanation: The physical and biological surroundings in their unaltered state, including ecosystems, landscapes, waterways, and wildlife habitats. Frequently used in environmental discussions and policy.

examples.japanese: {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}を{守|まも}る。
{開発|かいはつ}が{自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}に{与|あた}える{影響|えいきょう}を{調査|ちょうさ}する。
examples.english: We investigate the impact of development on the natural environment.

examples.japanese: この{島|しま}は{豊|ゆた}かな{自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}が{残|のこ}されており、{世界遺産|せかいいさん}に{登録|とうろく}されている。
examples.english: This island has preserved a rich natural environment and is registered as a World Heritage site.

notes:
Composed of {自然|しぜん} (nature) and {環境|かんきょう} (environment). A key term in environmental science, policy, and everyday discussion about ecology and conservation. Frequently appears in news about development projects, conservation efforts, and climate change.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}を{保全|ほぜん}する: to conserve the natural environment
- {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}の{破壊|はかい}: destruction of the natural environment
- {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}に{配慮|はいりょ}する: to be considerate of the natural environment
- {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}{調査|ちょうさ}: environmental survey

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {環境|かんきょう}: environment — broader; includes social and living environments as well as natural
- {生態系|せいたいけい}: ecosystem — more technical; refers to the interconnected system of organisms and their environment
- {自然|しぜん}: nature — the general concept; {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう} is more specific to the surrounding conditions
